title.narrative: Sustainable food production for poverty reduction in Rwanda-Concern Worldwide

description.narrative:
Description

The global objective of this action is to strengthen food security and nutrition in Rwanda.

The specific objective of this action is to promote food production from socially and environmentally sustainable agriculture in Gisagara and Nyaruguru district

The priorities of this action are to improve the knowledge and skills of farmers in sustainable land husbandry, Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA), and agroforestry; to increase the access to local markets and financial resources for farmers; to enhance the community knowledge on good nutrition practices within the households.
